headlines.title: Maersk completes first U.S. ethanol bunkering of a deep-sea container vessel
headlines.content_summary: A.P. Moller – Maersk (Maersk) announced the successful bunkering of Tangier Maersk, a dual-fuel alcohol-enabled container vessel, using U.S.-produced corn ethanol. The operation marked the first ship-to-ship commercial ethanol bunkering of a deep-sea container vessel in the United States.
